Google Kubernetes Engine: Change (October 26, 2026)
changes.detail: (2026-R45) Version updates GKE cluster versions have been updated. New versions available for upgrades and new clusters. The following versions are now available for new GKE clusters, and for manual control plane upgrades and node upgrades for existing clusters. For more information about versioning and upgrades, see GKE versioning and support and About GKE cluster upgrades .

changes.detail: Note : Your clusters might not have these versions available. changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Security (October 26, 2026)
changes.detail: (2026-R45) Security updates This release includes new GKE versions that use updated Container-Optimized OS images. These updated images are cumulative, incorporating security fixes from all Container-Optimized OS versions released since the previous GKE release. To identify the specific vulnerabilities that were resolved in each updated Container-Optimized OS image, see the Security release notes for that image.
